newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian sugar crush - week to July 5.
newsitem.headline: Australian sugar crush - week to July 5.

text.p: Australia's sugar cane crush totalled 1,496,826 tonnes in the week ended July 5, bringing the crush so far this year to 4.05 million tonnes, grower organisation CANEGROWERS said.

This is behind the 4.08 million tonnes crushed at the same time last year. CANEGROWERS reported for crushing week five of the 1997 season that average commercial cane sugar (ccs) content was 12.50 percent.
The figures do not include cane crushed in the Ord River region of Western Australia.
